title: From Reporters to Robots: How AI is Reshaping Journalism
description: Artificial intelligence transforms journalism with automated reporting, fact-checking, and personalized news, raising questions about bias and trust.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in journalism, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in journalism, including journalists, editors, platform teams, and readers tracking information systems.
